propositions: Model tier selection is inferred from equality tests against default model rather than explicitly configured, causing silent loss of per-pass downgrades when non-framework models are used
A single scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL cannot express per-pass provider/model mapping, and separate scalars do not solve the fundamental one-to-many routing problem
Plan-review Pass-1 ladder resolves to direct Anthropic provider instead of respecting the configured provider because bare model names are mapped at load time without provider context

Class names (trivial/standard/frontier) must be resolved at three distinct call sites—config.resolve_model, batch runner ladder expansion, and verifier path—not at a single funnel, to avoid bypasses that leave class names unresolved

Deep merging of LLM config slots and array replacement (not append) of fallback chains is required so operators can override one key without restating the entire class configuration and can clear or reorder fallback chains

A two-provider gate run confirmed per-pass class routing works end-to-end across provider boundaries, with Pass-1 escalation to frontier (Anthropic) and verifier downgrade to standard (Bedrock) executing the intended split while Bedrock inference-profile IDs (us.anthropic.claude-*) are required instead of plain model IDs
